fields.summary: Login page returns 500 for passwords with special characters
fields.description: Users report that logging in with passwords containing @, #, or ! triggers a 500 error. Stack-trace shows NullPointerException in AuthController.login().

fields.summary: SSO redirect loop after SAML assertion
fields.description: After successful SAML assertion, the service provider redirects the user back to the identity provider in an infinite loop. Seen with Okta and Azure AD.

fields.summary: Remember-me token not invalidated on logout
fields.description: The persistent authentication cookie is not cleared server-side when the user logs out. Revisiting the site within the token TTL re-authenticates without prompting.

fields.summary: Password reset email not delivered when username has uppercase letters
fields.description: The password-reset flow lowercases the stored email before querying but not the lookup key, causing a miss and no email delivery.

fields.summary: Session expires too quickly under heavy load
fields.description: Under high concurrency the session store TTL renewal is skipped, causing users to be logged out after ~5 minutes instead of the configured 30 minutes.

fields.summary: OAuth2 PKCE flow fails on Safari 17
fields.description: The code-verifier is not correctly percent-encoded on Safari 17. Authorization code exchange returns invalid_grant.

fields.summary: Two-factor authentication bypass via direct URL access
fields.description: A user who has 2FA enabled can skip the verification step by navigating directly to the post-login URL. The middleware guard is missing on those routes.

fields.summary: LDAP authentication fails when DN contains comma
fields.description: Distinguished names that include a comma (e.g. OU=Sales, Inc) break the LDAP bind call because the DN is not properly escaped.

fields.summary: Dashboard takes >10 seconds to load for accounts with >500 projects
fields.description: The project list query performs N+1 selects against the permissions table. Adding an eager-load join should fix this.

fields.summary: Search results timeout for queries with more than 3 filter criteria
fields.description: ElasticSearch queries with compound filters time out after 5 s. Query planning shows missing composite index on (status, priority, assignee).

fields.summary: PDF export hangs when report contains more than 200 rows
fields.description: The PDF renderer loads all rows into memory at once. Streaming or pagination is required to prevent OOM and timeout.

fields.summary: API response time degrades linearly with number of open issues
fields.description: The /api/issues endpoint re-counts total open issues on every request. Caching the count or using a materialized view would improve latency.

fields.summary: Slow startup time when connection pool is exhausted
fields.description: If all database connections are occupied during application startup, the health-check endpoint times out and Kubernetes restarts the pod unnecessarily.

fields.summary: Bulk import endpoint blocks the event loop for >30 seconds
fields.description: CSV import is processed synchronously in the request handler. Moving it to a background task queue would unblock the worker.

fields.summary: Notification fan-out causes latency spikes during peak hours
fields.description: Sending notifications to all project members is done synchronously in a loop. At peak, 800+ notifications block the worker thread for 45 seconds.

fields.summary: Autocomplete suggestions lag by 2-3 seconds on slow networks
fields.description: The autocomplete widget waits for the full response before rendering. Streaming or progressive rendering would improve perceived performance.

fields.summary: Dropdown menu overflows viewport on mobile screens
fields.description: On viewports narrower than 375px the dropdown overflows to the right. Adding overflow-x: hidden and a max-width constraint fixes the issue.

fields.summary: Dark mode toggle resets to light mode after page refresh
fields.description: The user preference is stored only in React state and not persisted to localStorage. After a hard refresh the theme reverts to the default.

fields.summary: Table column resizing broken in Firefox 120
fields.description: The drag-to-resize handler uses a deprecated Mouse-Events API that Firefox 120 removed. PointerEvents API should be used instead.

fields.summary: Tooltip z-index conflicts with modal overlay
fields.description: When a tooltip is triggered inside a modal, it renders behind the overlay backdrop due to a lower z-index stacking context.

fields.summary: File upload button not accessible via keyboard navigation
fields.description: The custom file-input widget suppresses the native focus ring and has no tabindex, making it unreachable without a mouse.

fields.summary: Date picker shows incorrect month when locale uses non-Gregorian calendar
fields.description: The date-picker component assumes the Gregorian calendar. Persian and Hebrew locales display the wrong month header.

fields.summary: Sidebar layout breaks when browser zoom is set to 150%
fields.description: At 150% zoom the CSS grid overflows and the main content panel is hidden behind the sidebar.

fields.summary: Icon buttons missing aria-label causing screen-reader issues
fields.description: Buttons that display only an icon have no accessible name. Screen readers announce them as unlabelled, failing WCAG 2.1 AA.

fields.summary: Foreign key violation on concurrent ticket creation
fields.description: Under concurrent load two requests try to insert a ticket with the same parent_id. One succeeds, the other raises a foreign-key constraint error because the parent was not yet committed.

fields.summary: Migration fails on PostgreSQL 18 due to reserved keyword
fields.description: Column named 'value' was reserved in PostgreSQL 18. ALTER TABLE rename is needed before running migration 0043.

fields.summary: Deadlock detected when bulk-updating issue statuses
fields.description: Two background jobs update overlapping sets of issues in opposite order, causing a deadlock. Using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE with a consistent ordering fixes this.

fields.summary: Connection pool exhausted after failed transaction rollback
fields.description: If an exception occurs mid-transaction and the rollback is not called, the connection is returned in a dirty state and eventually exhausts the pool.

fields.summary: Full-text search index not updated after issue rename
fields.description: The tsvector index on the issues table is populated via a trigger that fires only on INSERT, not on UPDATE. Renaming an issue makes the old title searchable.

fields.summary: Cascade delete removes child records before parent audit log is written
fields.description: The ON DELETE CASCADE constraint fires before the audit trigger, resulting in orphaned audit entries that reference deleted rows.

fields.summary: JSONB query fails with parse error for null values in nested objects
fields.description: The jsonb_path_query function returns an error when traversing a path that contains null mid-level nodes. Explicit null checks are required.

fields.summary: Slow query plan chosen for paginated results with large offsets
fields.description: OFFSET-based pagination on the issues table degrades to sequential scan after page 50. Keyset pagination (WHERE id > last_seen_id) would maintain consistent performance.

fields.summary: Add bulk label assignment from issue list view
fields.description: Users want to select multiple issues and apply or remove labels in one action without opening each issue individually.

fields.summary: Implement Slack integration for issue notifications
fields.description: Teams want to receive create/update/close notifications in a designated Slack channel. The integration should support per-project channel configuration.

fields.summary: Support custom fields in CSV export
fields.description: The CSV export currently only includes built-in fields. Users want to include custom fields and choose column order.

fields.summary: Add issue dependency graph visualization
fields.description: Product managers want a visual graph showing blocking/blocked-by relationships between issues, similar to a dependency map.

fields.summary: Implement SLA tracking for customer-reported issues
fields.description: Support teams need automatic SLA timers that trigger escalation emails when response or resolution deadlines are approaching.

fields.summary: Allow markdown in issue descriptions
fields.description: Currently only plain text is supported. Teams want to use **bold**, *italic*, code blocks, and bullet lists in issue descriptions.

fields.summary: Add recurring issue templates for weekly maintenance tasks
fields.description: DevOps teams create the same maintenance tasks every week. A scheduling feature that auto-creates issues from templates would save time.

fields.summary: Provide REST API endpoint for issue analytics
fields.description: Data teams want to pull issue metrics (created vs closed, average age, throughput by team) via API instead of using the UI reports.
